answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 36967 Country: India Title: I am a 31 year old man and had developed the problem of drinking and smoking Question: I am a 31 year old man and had developed the problem of drinking and smoking; I am trying my best to quit both the habits for which I have quit alcohol almost 90%. Please suggest a wazifah or amal that I can do to quit my habit of intoxication. It is very important for me because I am not able to do it myself. I have been trying for a long time now. Answer ID: 36967 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 263/205/B=1433) When you have abstained drinking almost 90% then it is very easy for you to quit 10% as well. You should make firm intention to keep yourself away from drinking wine anymore. If you make firm intention in-shaAllah you shall be able to abstain this 10% as well. Just with such determination and firmness you would be able to give up that 10% of drinking. Also ask for supplication from any pious person of your area. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
